dogecoin.text: 1/ Twitter has foiled Market Musings 2x today so this tweetstorm will have to do. What’s new? Companies are struggling to hire, unemployment is on the rise, people are making more off unemployment than min wage, and Dogecoin is back at it.

5/ Elon Musk has talked up the token on twitter and SNL, driving retail interest. Other factors also primed the market for a surge in Dogecoin interest: stimulus checks, the ease of buying DOGE in Robinhood and other apps, and the “stick it to the establishment” zeitgeist.

3/ Background on Dogecoin: in 2013, 2 software engineers launched the cryptocurrency as a way to make fun of bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies that boasted grand plans to take over the world. It wasn’t intended to be anything more than a fun alternative to bitcoin.

1/ It wouldn’t be a Market Musings week without discussing crypto or SPACs. This week it’s Dogecoin. The satirical cryptocurrency branded after a viral dog meme, hit a new all time high last Friday afternoon. It reached a market cap of ~$92B after a 6 month climb of 26,000%.
